ex.en: We have a verbal agreement, but nothing in writing.
ex.zh: 我們有口頭協議，但沒有書面文件。

ex.en: He received a verbal warning from his manager.
ex.zh: 他被主管口頭警告。

ex.en: I don't need your verbal gentleness.
ex.zh: 我不需要你嘴上的溫柔。

ex.en: She has excellent verbal skills.
ex.zh: 她的語言表達能力很好。

vend.zh: 販賣（常見於 vending machine 自動販賣機）

ex.en: This vending machine isn't working.
ex.zh: 這台自動販賣機壞了。

ex.en: The vending machines are over there.
ex.zh: 自動販賣機在那邊。

ex.en: They installed a vending machine at work.
ex.zh: 他們在公司裝了一台自動販賣機。

ex.en: Draw a vertical line down the middle of the page.
ex.zh: 在頁面中間畫一條垂直線。

ex.en: The cliff is almost vertical.
ex.zh: 這座懸崖幾乎是垂直的。

ex.en: The President of the United States has the power to veto and send back legislation.
ex.zh: 美國總統有權否決法案並將其退回。

ex.en: The board vetoed the proposal.
ex.zh: 董事會否決了這項提案。

ex.en: The manager has a veto over all hiring decisions.
ex.zh: 經理對所有聘用決定都有否決權。

ex.en: Each member has the right of veto.
ex.zh: 每位成員都有否決權。

ex.en: You need to reverse your vest, it's back to front.
ex.zh: 你的背心穿反了，前後顛倒了。

ex.en: Life vests are located under your seats.
ex.zh: 救生衣在您的座位底下。

ex.en: He pinned the badge on his vest.
ex.zh: 他把徽章別在背心上。

vest.zh: 授予（權力）；（股票選擇權等）歸屬、生效

ex.en: The board is vested with the power to hire the CEO.
ex.zh: 董事會被授予聘任執行長的權力。

ex.en: Your stock options will vest after three years.
ex.zh: 你的員工認股權三年後才會生效。

ex.en: A vector is a unit vector if its norm is 1.
ex.zh: 範數為 1 的向量稱為單位向量。

ex.en: A vector has both size and direction.
ex.zh: 向量同時具有大小和方向。

ex.en: Mosquitoes are a vector for many diseases.
ex.zh: 蚊子是許多疾病的傳播媒介。

ex.en: Email remains a common vector for cyberattacks.
ex.zh: 電子郵件仍是網路攻擊的常見途徑。

ex.en: English is a very important language in today's world.
ex.zh: 英語在當今世界是非常重要的語言。

ex.en: He would be very glad to hear the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到這個消息一定會很高興。

ex.en: This is the very book I was looking for.
ex.zh: 這正是我在找的那本書。

ex.en: At that very moment, the phone rang.
ex.zh: 就在那一刻，電話響了。

ex.en: The input method also works with this version.
ex.zh: 這個輸入法也適用於這個版本。

ex.en: I've heard the French version of this song.
ex.zh: 我聽過這首歌的法文版。

ex.en: This dictionary isn't the most recent version.
ex.zh: 這本字典不是最新版。

ex.en: They gave different versions of the accident.
ex.zh: 他們對這起事故有不同的說法。

ex.en: I don't believe Tom's version of the story.
ex.zh: 我不相信湯姆的說法。

ex.en: The number of motor vehicles in the city has increased.
ex.zh: 市區的機動車輛數量增加了。

ex.en: Lightning struck the vehicle.
ex.zh: 閃電擊中了那輛車。

ex.en: Please do not leave your vehicle unattended.
ex.zh: 請勿將車輛留置無人看管。

ex.en: Music is a powerful vehicle for expressing feelings.
ex.zh: 音樂是表達情感的有力媒介。

ex.en: Social media is an important vehicle for marketing.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是重要的行銷工具。

ex.en: We bought some vegetables and fish at the market.
ex.zh: 我們在市場買了一些蔬菜和魚。

ex.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 蔬果是均衡飲食不可或缺的。

ex.en: The price of vegetables varies from day to day.
ex.zh: 蔬菜價格每天都在變。

ex.en: Who will provide capital for the venture?
ex.zh: 誰會為這項事業提供資金？

ex.en: They started a joint venture in Vietnam.
ex.zh: 他們在越南成立了一家合資企業。

ex.en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.
ex.zh: 不入虎穴，焉得虎子。

ex.en: We ventured out into the rain to buy food.
ex.zh: 我們冒雨出門去買食物。

ex.en: She is a veteran of the advertising industry.
ex.zh: 她是廣告業的老手。

ex.en: He's a 20-year veteran of the company.
ex.zh: 他在公司待了 20 年，是資深員工。

ex.en: Tom is a Vietnam veteran.
ex.zh: 湯姆是越戰退伍軍人。

ex.en: The city held a ceremony to honor its veterans.
ex.zh: 市政府舉辦典禮表揚退伍軍人。

ex.en: A veteran reporter covered the story.
ex.zh: 一位資深記者負責報導這則新聞。

ex.en: The team is led by a veteran coach.
ex.zh: 這支球隊由一位經驗豐富的教練帶領。

ex.en: The cargo vessel arrived at the port this morning.
ex.zh: 那艘貨船今天早上抵達港口。

ex.en: Several fishing vessels were damaged in the storm.
ex.zh: 好幾艘漁船在暴風雨中受損。

ex.en: Exercise keeps your blood vessels healthy.
ex.zh: 運動能讓血管保持健康。

ex.en: A blood vessel in his eye burst.
ex.zh: 他眼睛裡有一條血管破了。

ex.en: Store the oil in a clean glass vessel.
ex.zh: 把油存放在乾淨的玻璃容器裡。

ex.en: This ancient vessel was used for storing wine.
ex.zh: 這個古老的器皿是用來裝酒的。

ex.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
ex.zh: 一個句子通常有主詞和動詞。

ex.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡背不規則動詞。

ex.en: This verb is normally used only in the third person.
ex.zh: 這個動詞通常只用在第三人稱。

ex.en: The island is covered in thick vegetation.
ex.zh: 這座島上草木茂密。

ex.en: There is very little vegetation in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠裡幾乎沒有什麼植物。

ex.en: When he shouted, the veins in his neck stood out clearly.
ex.zh: 他大吼的時候，脖子上青筋暴露。

ex.en: The nurse took blood from a vein in my arm.
ex.zh: 護理師從我手臂的靜脈抽血。

ex.en: The rest of the speech continued in the same vein.
ex.zh: 演講的其餘部分延續同樣的風格。

ex.en: He spoke in a more serious vein this time.
ex.zh: 這次他說話的語氣嚴肅多了。

ex.en: The wind reached a velocity of 150 kilometers per hour.
ex.zh: 風速達到每小時 150 公里。

ex.en: Light travels at a constant velocity.
ex.zh: 光以固定的速度前進。

ex.en: She's vegetarian, so she ate tofu instead of turkey.
ex.zh: 她是素食者，所以她沒吃火雞，而是吃了豆腐。

ex.en: Tom and I are both vegetarians.
ex.zh: 我和湯姆都吃素。

ex.en: Tom's new girlfriend is a vegetarian.
ex.zh: 湯姆的新女朋友吃素。

ex.en: Can you recommend any vegetarian dishes?
ex.zh: 可以推薦幾道素食料理嗎？

ex.en: Do you have vegetarian pilaf?
ex.zh: 你們有素的手抓飯嗎？

ex.en: His constant lateness vexed his boss.
ex.zh: 他老是遲到，讓老闆很惱火。

ex.en: It vexes me that nobody listens to my advice.
ex.zh: 沒有人聽我的建議，讓我很氣惱。

ex.en: Mary took her dog to the vet.
ex.zh: 瑪莉帶她的狗去看獸醫。

ex.en: We took our cat to the vet for a vaccination.
ex.zh: 我們帶貓去獸醫那裡打預防針。

ex.en: The vet said my dog needs to lose some weight.
ex.zh: 獸醫說我的狗需要減肥。

ex.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.
ex.zh: 我可以親自證實那是真的。

ex.en: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
ex.zh: 關於以下內容，我想確認兩件事。

ex.en: The jury's guilty verdict gave rise to widespread debate.
ex.zh: 陪審團的有罪判決引發了廣泛的爭論。

ex.en: The jury will announce its verdict tomorrow.
ex.zh: 陪審團明天將宣布判決。

ex.en: What's your verdict on the new restaurant?
ex.zh: 你覺得那家新餐廳怎麼樣？

ex.en: The verdict from the critics was positive.
ex.zh: 評論家的評價是正面的。

ex.en: Our venue wasn't renovated too long ago.
ex.zh: 我們的場地不久前才翻新過。

ex.en: Inside the venue, sounds of clapping, whistling, yelling, laughing blended together.
ex.zh: 會場裡，鼓掌聲、口哨聲、喊叫聲和笑聲混成一片。

ex.en: The ventilation here is really bad.
ex.zh: 這裡的通風很差呢。

ex.en: This room has fine ventilation.
ex.zh: 這房間的通風裝置很好。

ex.en: The ventilation system needs regular maintenance.
ex.zh: 通風系統需要定期保養。

ex.en: Better ventilation will improve the air quality.
ex.zh: 改善通風能提升空氣品質。

ex.en: The startup raised venture capital from two firms.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司向兩家公司募得創業投資。

ex.en: Venture capital helped fund the product launch.
ex.zh: 創業投資協助支付產品上市所需資金。

ex.en: The bank requires verification of your identity.
ex.zh: 銀行要求查證你的身分。

ex.en: Email verification is needed to activate the account.
ex.zh: 必須完成電子郵件驗證才能啟用帳戶。

ex.en: The restaurant labels every dish suitable for a vegan.
ex.zh: 餐廳標示出每道適合純素者的餐點。

ex.en: As a vegan, he checks ingredient lists for hidden dairy.
ex.zh: 身為純素者，他會檢查成分表是否含有隱藏的乳製品。

ex.en: Ali's grandfather is a tea vendor.
ex.zh: 阿里的祖父是賣茶的小販。

ex.en: The street vendor sells fried chicken.
ex.zh: 那個路邊攤販賣炸雞。

ex.en: We work with several software vendors.
ex.zh: 我們跟好幾家軟體廠商合作。

ex.en: The vendor will deliver the equipment next week.
ex.zh: 廠商下週會送來設備。
